title: Robot senses
about: Cameras, ultrasonic, touch and gyro sensors, and how they work.

html: • Camera: sees colors and shapes, like your eyes.
• Ultrasonic: measures distance with sound you can't hear, like a bat.
• Touch: feels when it bumps into something.
• Gyro: feels tilting and turning, like your inner ear.
It sends out a short beep and times how long the echo takes to come back. Sound travels about 343 meters per second.
The sound goes there and back, so: distance = 343 × time ÷ 2.
Example: the echo comes back in 0.01 seconds. 343 × 0.01 ÷ 2 ≈ 1.7 meters to the wall.

steps.q: An ultrasonic echo comes back in 0.02 seconds. About how far away is the wall?
steps.explain: 343 × 0.02 = 6.86 meters there and back. Divide by 2: about 3.4 m.

steps.q: In Bot Arena, which sensor gives a robot the best aim?
steps.explain: The camera sees the target clearly. Ultrasonic helps you dodge, and Touch is light but aims poorly.
